name: OpenCode
description: Local agent harness via the opencode CLI. Runs a headless mission per turn (`opencode run --format json`) over a deterministic per-unit session, and can also answer live sessions through the local opencode service. The OPENCODE unit type in RepoCiv is a direct bypass to this harness — no cascade fallback.
auth: none (local binary + shared opencode service; provider auth managed by `opencode auth`)

session.note: Sessions under the reserved `ses_repociv-` prefix are skipped by the external-agents source: the mission's own unit already stands on the map.

model_selection: -m provider/model[#variant] flag; user selects via the UI model picker
output: --format json emits NDJSON events (step_start, tool_use, step_finish, text, error); RepoCiv streams text/tool events into the chat and treats an error event or a non-zero exit as failure
note: OPENCODE always routes directly to this harness regardless of the harness selector in the UI.

profile_binding.harness_ref_semantics: OpenCode agent name passed to --agent (e.g. 'build', 'plan'). Use 'default' to omit the flag.

identity_mode.native: Edit AGENTS.md in the project (or ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md globally)

profile_binding.harness_options_note: Agent names are defined in opencode.json (agent section) or ~/.config/opencode/agent/
